One canonical deployment, port 8080

This is the compiled entry point for the AeroVigilAI browser console. The native Flutter clients and this web console both talk to the same API surface under /api. Model inference is served at POST /api/model.

Framework job queue

Queue train / evaluate / export / federated / active-learning / SHAP jobs on the durable queue (POST /api/jobs/{type}) and follow their live logs (GET /api/jobs/{id}).
